name: FrenchModelVariant431_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant431_entry.c (through model_variant/variant414_entry.c with the North American palette x 512): the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the 104-byte descriptor at data + 0xFC indexed by the request, gets five slot parts and packs four texture images before setting up five companion bands, three webs, five fans, six sheets, six rings and four spokes, otherwise it runs one frame (fans, sheets and bands from their descriptor timings, webs from phase 2) and returns 4 in phases 2-4, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in all fourteen model-401 stage-7/8 images; French header numbering (North American header 414); HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
